tasks.label: Run Flask Dev Server
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Push-Location "C:\Users\pc123\OneDrive\Documents\pineflip"; $py = Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($py) { py -3.13 -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt"; py -3.13 "flipper-pineapple-manager\app.py" } else { python -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt"; python "flipper-pineapple-manager\app.py" }

tasks.label: Run Flask Dev Server (AutoConnect)
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Push-Location "C:\Users\pc123\OneDrive\Documents\pineflip"; $py = Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($py) { py -3.13 -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt" } else { python -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt" }; $env:AUTO_CONNECT_FLIPPER = "1"; $env:AUTO_CONNECT_PINEAPPLE = "0"; if ($py) { py -3.13 "flipper-pineapple-manager\app.py" } else { python "flipper-pineapple-manager\app.py" }

tasks.label: Run Flask Dev Server (Pineapple Creds, 5001)
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Push-Location "C:\Users\pc123\OneDrive\Documents\pineflip"; $py = Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($py) { py -3.13 -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt" } else { python -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt" }; $env:PINEAPPLE_USER = "root"; $env:PINEAPPLE_PASS = "flooding"; $env:AUTO_CONNECT_PINEAPPLE = "1"; $env:FLASK_APP = "flipper-pineapple-manager\app.py"; if ($py) { py -3.13 -m flask run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5001 } else { python -m flask run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5001 }

tasks.label: Run Flask Dev Server (Pineapple Creds, 5001) - retry
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Push-Location "C:\Users\pc123\OneDrive\Documents\pineflip"; $py = Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($py) { py -3.13 -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt" } else { python -m pip install -r "flipper-pineapple-manager\requirements.txt" }; $env:PINEAPPLE_USER = 'root'; $env:PINEAPPLE_PASS = 'flooding'; $env:AUTO_CONNECT_PINEAPPLE = '1'; $env:FLASK_APP = 'flipper-pineapple-manager\app.py'; if ($py) { py -3.13 -m flask run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5001 } else { python -m flask run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5001 }

tasks.label: Verify Pineapple Network (5001)
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri http://127.0.0.1:5001/status/pineapple_network -TimeoutSec 5 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri http://127.0.0.1:5001/pineapple_status -TimeoutSec 8 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content } catch { $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Verify Pineapple Network (5001, longer timeout)
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri http://127.0.0.1:5001/status/pineapple_network -TimeoutSec 15 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri http://127.0.0.1:5001/pineapple_status -TimeoutSec 20 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content } catch { $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: Check Pineapple USB Network
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; ipconfig | Out-String; Test-Connection -ComputerName 172.16.42.1 -Count 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
